G1_no_catchup_stops_for_one_request.detail: A write that cannot prepare is cut off at 120 s and finished preparation_stalled by 240 s, and its file is held; no pass stopped on a single request in the five reporter-shape passes. Under a table lock the head member is held at 240 s, but nine of ten pool connections stay pinned until the lock drops (#6318), and the pass under that lock ended on queue_capacity before lane B7 (fixed, tested locally, not rerun). The never-settling await the reporter found is raced by the same budget and covered by gbrain forced-fault tests; this bench did not reproduce it.

G2_writer_status_names_the_step.detail: Every overdue claim (39 in the first lock run, 19 in the second) carried claim.stall with step, step age, wait cause and budget. diagnostic.reason still reads cause_unknown on the same rows.

G3_fence_defects_never_consume_the_write.detail: 0 fence refusals at preparation in both 15,000-entry runs (471 and 276 on the throughput head); 20 marker pages held with the reason; whitespace and CRLF facts adopt; whitespace-only rows are counted.

G4_fence_repair_runs_during_the_sync.detail: 22 candidates, all held sync_in_progress, none repaired, no owner_unavailable. Scoped to the follow-up change.

G5_throughput_and_one_pass.verdict: rate and watchdog met; one pass not met at a 3600 s timeout
G5_throughput_and_one_pass.one_pass_at_14400s: met by arithmetic: 5,483 s of passes at pool 10 and about 10,800 s plus a short tail at pool 3; no run used a 14,400 s timeout
